requirements.statement: A Customer can sign in so their bookings are saved to their account

criteria.must: A Customer can sign in via SSO
After signing in, the Customer's bookings are associated with their account and visible on return visits

requirements.statement: A Customer can browse the services a business offers and read their descriptions

criteria.must: A signed-in Customer can view a list of the business's services
Each listed service shows its description

requirements.statement: A Customer can see available time slots for a chosen service

criteria.must: After choosing a service, the Customer sees a list of open time slots for it
A time slot that is already booked or outside working hours is not offered

requirements.statement: A Customer can book an appointment for a chosen service and time slot

criteria.must: The Customer can confirm a booking for a chosen service and open slot
A confirmed booking reserves the slot so it no longer appears as available to others

requirements.statement: A Customer can view their upcoming and past bookings

criteria.must: The Customer can view a list of their upcoming bookings
The Customer can view a list of their past bookings

requirements.statement: A Customer can cancel or reschedule an upcoming booking

criteria.must: The Customer can cancel one of their own upcoming bookings
The Customer can reschedule one of their own upcoming bookings to a different available slot
The Customer can cancel or reschedule at any time before the booking starts, with no minimum-notice cutoff enforced

requirements.statement: A Staff member can sign in securely so only authorized staff can manage services and bookings

criteria.must: A Staff member can sign in via SSO
A signed-in Customer cannot access the staff service/availability/calendar management screens

requirements.statement: A Staff member can define the services offered, including name, duration and description

criteria.must: A Staff member can create a new service with a name, duration and description
A newly created service becomes bookable by Customers

requirements.statement: A Staff member can set their working hours and availability

criteria.must: A Staff member can define their weekly working hours
Customers only see open slots that fall within the Staff member's defined working hours

requirements.statement: A Staff member can block out time such as holidays or breaks

criteria.must: A Staff member can block out a period of time as unavailable
Customers cannot book a slot that falls within a blocked-out period

requirements.statement: A Staff member can view all upcoming bookings on a calendar

criteria.must: A Staff member can view a calendar listing every upcoming booking across all customers

requirements.statement: A Staff member can cancel or reschedule a customer's booking on their behalf

criteria.must: A Staff member can cancel any customer's booking
A Staff member can reschedule any customer's booking to a different available slot
